description.value: At 12th level, a knight is accustomed to harsh conditions of hostile territory, both in the thick of battle and during travel. The knight gains Endurance as a bonus feat. If he already has that feat, he may select another feat for which he meets the prerequisites which lists Endurance as a prerequisite. In addition, he may sleep in medium or heavy armor without becoming fatigued, he requires half as much sleep as normal, and can survive twice as long without food and water before needing to make checks. Finally, the penalty for Perception checks made while the knight is sleeping is halved.
